remaining_gaps: The original ZIP lacks participant conversion fields. A temporary explicitly authorized repair from hash-verified local cards is supported; the archive author still needs to restore these fields for standalone ZIP-only replay.

Historical baseline payloads are byte-identical under baselines/task1_prededup_and_enhy_fix, not the current/deduplicated snapshots. The Task 3 catalog pins their paths without changing Task 1/2 defaults.
Original ZIP wrappers, private directory names, full consent schemas and parser-checkout audits are not distributed. Release runners use payload/member and staged-file provenance instead.
Reviewed base-model overrides are packaged from the original analysis configuration; some underlying model names cannot be reconstructed from the sanitized cards alone.
Historical PDF bytes contain renderer/time-dependent metadata. Verify numeric tables, selected figure content and vector rendering, not PDF-byte identity.
Archival WMT24/July-dump experiments and GPU regeneration of submitted predictions are outside the frozen current-results scope and are not all supported by this ZIP.
